audit_metadata.title: POLARIS EMS HD-02 Terminal Energy Target & EBR Relationship Audit

battery_state_equations.transition_equation: E[t+1] = E[t] + eta_chg * p_chg * dt - (p_dis / eta_dis) * dt

ebr_reconstruction.formula: E_EBR_target(t) = E_min_tech + sum_{k=t+1}^{t+N} D_critical(k) * dt / eta_dis

objective_options.Option_A: min sum_{t=1}^H max(0, E_EBR(t) - E(t)) [Zero Double-Counting]
objective_options.Option_B: min sum_{t=1}^{H-1} max(0, E_EBR(t) - E(t)) + max(0, E_EBR(H) - E(H)) [Zero Double-Counting]
objective_options.Option_C: min sum_{t=1}^H max(0, E_EBR(t) - E(t)) + max(0, E_EBR(H) - E(H)) [Double-Weighted Penalty at t=H]
objective_options.Option_D: min sum_{t=1}^H max(0, E_EBR(t) - E(t)) s.t. E(H) >= E_EBR(H) [Hard Boundary Constraint]
